PROCESS OPERATOR SPECIALIST, AIR SEPARATION UNIT (STARSHIP)

SpaceX is building its first production-scale Air Separation Unit (ASU) at Starbase to produce the high-purity liquid oxygen that powers Starship. This is not just another industrial plant—it is the critical on-site propellant factory that eliminates supply risk for the most ambitious launch vehicle ever built and lays the operational foundation for producing propellants on the Moon and Mars.

You will monitor process parameters, execute approved procedures, complete thorough field rounds, and qualify toward independent watch standing. If you thrive in high-stakes cryogenic environments, want to learn these systems from first principles, and want ownership of mission-critical hardware as you grow, this is the role for you.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Our Company Welcome to Energy Vault® (NYSE:NRGV), a global energy storage and power infrastructure company focused on owning, operating, and enabling resilient, dispatchable energy assets. Energy Vault’s focus is to deliver reliable, flexible power that supports the evolving needs of modern grids, communities, and large energy users. Since 2024, the Company has centered its strategy on an Independent Power Producer (IPP) model, developing, building, owning, and operating critical energy assets around the world. Energy Vault operates globally, with headquarters in Westlake Village, California and Lugano, Switzerland, and regional development across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The Company partners with utilities, grid operators, and large energy consumers to deliver infrastructure that strengthens grid reliability, enables renewable integration, and supports long-term energy security. jobs.description_text: Exowatt is revolutionizing the energy landscape for the AI era with our groundbreaking P3 system that captures solar energy, stores it as heat, and generates electricity on demand. Last cohort's interns shipped drones, sensor hardware, CAD tools and agent platforms, and demoed them to the team every two weeks. You'll do the same, with AI tools as part of how you work every day. This role is in person at our Miami, FL office.

You'll play a key role in unlocking new advertiser categories and driving sustainable net-new revenue growth.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Field Marketing Manager, Americas who is organized, relationship-driven, and results-focused to join our Regional Marketing team at Xsolla Global Headquarters in Los Angeles, California. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to turn a calendar of 70+ industry conferences, trade shows, Xsolla Connects, and partner events across the U.S., Canada, and LATAM into meetings, leads, and pipeline for Business Development. The ability to own a high-volume event calendar and coordinate several teams with competing priorities will be key to your success in this role. jobs.title: Senior Technical Account Manager, Xsolla Ads & Rewards
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU Xsolla Ads connects advertisers with players across Xsolla's games and commerce surfaces. Every dollar that moves through it depends on two kinds of integration working correctly: the oRTB connections to the DSPs and SSPs that buy and sell our inventory, and the MMP and event integrations that tell advertisers whether a player installed, registered, or made a purchase. You'll be the technical owner of those integrations for our strategic partners. That means you're the person a DSP calls when their bid rate falls off a cliff, the person an MMP works with to get postbacks mapped correctly, and the person who tells an advertiser exactly why their dashboard and ours disagree. You'll work with Partnerships, Product, Engineering, and Data, and you'll bring what partners need back into the roadmap in a form engineers can act on. ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world.
